requirementManagement.description: IDM- Upload valid ID proof of proposer (Passport - front & back or Driving License or Pan Card or Aadhaar - front & back)
GCR-Upload Graduation Certificate
KYP- Upload recent photograph of proposer
PST-Upload proposer passport (front & back)
AGE-Age proof of life assured (Passport - front & back or Driving License or Pan Card or Aadhaar - front & back)
UAC-UW Audit Confirmation Pending
RUA-Need to go for Urine test
H1C-Need to go for Blood test
MER-Physical Examination required
ACR -Agent confidential report not uploaded
OCD-Submit digital confirmation via Consent Code
IIN-Income proof of life assured matching with income declared in application
QNR -NRI Questionnaire required
ECG-Need to go for ECG test
HV1-Need to go for Blood test
COT-Need to go for Urine test
S13-Need to go for Blood test (Fasting not required)
PAL- Please submit PAN Card copy linked with your Aadhaar
ADP-Address proof of the proposer matching with application form (Passport - front & back or Aadhaar - front & back or Driving License or Voter id)
AUS-Blood Test
Upload signed (attested) copy of PAN Card or Form 60/61 or Form 97 of person purchasing this policy (Proposer)
